title: The Return of Cad Bane
description: Cad Bane is one of the most dangerous and notorious bounty hunters in the galaxy, with a reputation that stretches further back than the Clone Wars. He took part in many dangerous missions, jobs, and heists, and even took a young Boba Fett under his wing for a time. The two of them didn't always see eye to eye, so it's no wonder they found themselves on opposite sides of the conflict on Tatooine. But first, Cad Bane has to ensure that the people of Mos Pelgo stay out of the fight, and he goes there to threaten their marshal, Cobb Vanth.
